image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a weathered, dark teal or blue street sign mounted horizontally on a rough, textured stone wall. The sign features white, hand-painted or stenciled lettering in a non-Latin script (appearing to be Arabic or similar), which is partially obscured by wear and tear. The sign's surface shows significant aging, with chipped paint and rust spots. The background consists of irregular, light-colored stones and some sparse green vegetation at the top right.
